content.text: Pitch Black brings the Mega Evolution series into darker territory with Mega Darkrai ex and Mega Zeraora ex leading the expansion. Inspired by the Mega Dimension storyline of Pokémon Legends: Z-A, the set introduces new Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, powerful Pokémon ex, and a collection of collectible cards featuring Pokémon and Trainers from this mysterious new chapter.
